title: Death Laugh
description: Plays a laugh sound when someone dies.
body:
Plays a laugh sound effect to all players when someone dies.

The laugh sound is ravager celebrate sound.
It does not require a resource pack.
Currently there is no config to change the sound but it is planned.

# Version

This plugin should work from 1.14 to the latest version of minecraft.
